title: Chinna Jameen
desc: Rasaiya, a wealthy yet naive man, is raised by his abusive uncle, who covets his property. However, when his uncle kills Rasaiya's lover Jothi, he resolves to avenge her death.

title: Urimai Geetham
desc: When Bhoominathan, an honest politician is assassinated during a function by Thyagu, the latter denies the accusations and pleads his innocence. Soon Bhoomi's son sets out to find the real killer.

title: Unnai Charanadaindhen
desc: A sensible Nandha looks after Kannan, his carefree best friend. Things take a turn when Kannan falls in love with a girl and continues to interact with her despite Nandha's objections.

title: Azhagiya Theye
desc: Nandhini asks Chandran to sabotage her forced marriage to an NRI. However, Chandran's scheme backfires, leading their lives to take a surprising turn.

title: En Aasai Machan
desc: Arusamy, a village chief, remains unmarried in order to take care of Subramani, his younger brother. However, he has to pay a heavy price when Subramani falls in love with Meenakshi.
